condition: VTE prophylaxis — Caprini low risk (elective hernia repair)
summary: Fit 50-year-old for elective inguinal hernia repair with Caprini 1: mechanical prophylaxis; pharmacological prophylaxis not needed.

inputs.hpi: Several months of a right groin lump on standing that goes back lying down; mild ache only; never stuck. Otherwise fit.

exam.abdomen: Reducible right inguinal hernia with a cough impulse, controlled at the deep ring. Left groin normal.

confirmedDiagnosis.name: Right inguinal hernia, reducible, minimally symptomatic
confirmedDiagnosis.assessmentText: Reducible right inguinal hernia — planned elective laparoscopic repair.

guideline.name: ACCP 9th edition — VTE prevention in non-orthopaedic surgery
guideline.citation: Gould MK et al. Chest 2012;141(2 Suppl):e227S-e277S.

guideline.name: NICE NG89 VTE prophylaxis in over 16s

rationale: ACCP 2012: low risk (Caprini 1-2, about 1.5%) — mechanical prophylaxis; LMWH from moderate risk (Caprini 3-4).
